Chapter 13: The Role of Environment and Association.
You’ve probably heard that saying—you become the average of the people you spend the most time with. It sounds simple, but you know what? For most of us, it’s something we only realize after we’ve felt it shaping us… bit by bit.
Picture this: someone stuck in a rut, feeling like nothing ever changes. They look around and notice their friends are all perfectly comfortable with how things are. There’s a certain comfort in that sameness, sure—but it can also start to feel a little stifling. It wasn’t until this person found a new circle—a group that was curious, motivated, and genuinely supportive—that something shifted. Suddenly, new ideas started popping up. Old limits didn’t seem so set in stone. Motivation came back, almost as if by magic.
Most of us don’t realize just how much our surroundings and the people in them shape our choices. Think about it: the cues around you, the expectations people have, the general vibe—they can either give you that extra push or quietly hold you back. So, if you’re intentional about who you spend your time with, you’re creating a setting that actually encourages your growth.
But here’s something important: it’s not about dumping old friends or chasing after people just because they look “successful.” What really matters is finding folks who share your values, who push you to be better, and who are genuinely happy to see you make progress. Over time, those relationships turn into a source of strength, inspiration, and real accountability.
And let’s not forget about your physical environment. Sometimes, something as simple as a cluttered desk, a noisy workspace, or a negative atmosphere can drain your energy and creativity. But small changes—like tidying up your space, carving out a quiet nook, or connecting with positive communities—can make a huge difference.
So, if you’re looking for a boost, maybe it’s time to take a closer look at the people and places you surround yourself with. That little shift could open up more possibilities than you think.
